rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: enacted 8 December 2017, Gazette 23 December 2017, in force 15 January 2018 (Proclamation No. 3 of 2018); repealed the 2004 Act, modelled on the EU GDPR; Data Protection Office headed by the Data Protection Commissioner handles complaints and enforcement notices.
